Java source supports the account's core model: CommandArrow captures ARROW_STYLE between the arrow body halves, CommandExoArrowRight/Left reuse CommandArrow.getColorOrStylePattern for external found/lost messages, and CommandArrow.applyStyle tokenizes in source order with dashed/dotted selecting DOTTED, hidden selecting HIDDEN, bold as a no-op, and other accepted tokens resolved as colors.

Static review found no production reads of golden data, fixture names, review labels, branch-count ladders, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, or unexplained new high-precision constants in the 59169b2a implementation diff; git diff --check is clean. However, the Rust recognizer is broader than the Java model: strip_arrow_style_annotation and has_inline_arrow_style scan the whole pre-colon header, then INLINE_ARROW_STYLE.replace(head, "") removes the first style-looking bracket anywhere in that header rather than constraining the match to the parsed arrow body slot.
